turn_text: Interesting. So what are some of the solutions there that you think would work on this? I mean, are there one, two, three particular policy prescriptions that you think could really, really be helpful in terms of addressing poverty?

I work with the laboratory of economic opportunity at Notre Dame and we're running trials on this right now at places across the country to really figure out how best to do this so that this kind of service can be scaled and replicated using tech and to add an analytics to really move the needle. And then we were trying to build a system that can be replicated across the country.
